market.method: ~1.3 Mt/yr input (Fraunhofer EU 262 kt x 5) x ~70% oil yield (est.) = 0.9 Mt x ~$480/t = $0.44B
market.job_what: catalyst used in plastic pyrolysis/cracking to fuel oil, world (much pyrolysis is thermal, no catalyst)
market.job_method: est.: ~1.3 Mt/yr plastic pyrolysed x ~1-3 kg catalyst/t x ~$3/kg (E-cat $0.35-0.9/kg, zeolites higher) = ~$4-12M; report $1.8B 'chem-recycling catalyst' not credible; low confidence

value.logic: Fleet ~5 Mt/yr input by ~2032 (est.); catalyst adds +10 pts liquid yield (0.1 t x $600) and diesel-range, low-Cl quality (+$150/t on 0.8 t) = ~$180/t x 5 Mt = $0.9B
value.revenue_logic: Catalyst use ~2 kg/t (est., FCC-like makeup) x 5 Mt = 10 kt x $6/kg = $60M market x 15% share
value.margin_logic: Modified zeolite, toll made; FCC-type catalysts run 30-45%

trend.drivers: Pyrolysis capacity projected 1.3 -> 2.1 Mt but many delays (Lux); EU RED III counts recycled-carbon fuels; fuel route does not count as recycling under PPWR
trend.deadline: EU PPWR recycled content 2030 (35% non-contact plastic; fuel output does not count)

competition.paper_query: mixed plastic waste catalytic pyrolysis fuel
competition.notes: Most crowded science of the batch. Exxon 500 kt/yr catalytic plant at Baytown (2024 start). Lux: pyrolysis delivery disappointing; fuel is the lowest-value outlet

lab.synth: Catalog zeolite (ZSM-5/Y) + desilication or Ni/Co impregnation, 3-5 variants; solid catalyst, no CRO route
lab.test: Lab fixed/fluid-bed pyrolysis of PE/PP/PS/PET/PVC mix at 450-550 C; liquid yield, simdist ASTM D2887, Cl ASTM D7359, PIONA ASTM D6730, coke/deactivation over cycles; university lab
lab.logic: Catalyst prep + XRD/BET 5 wk, $12k; reactor runs + analytics 8 wk, ~$30k; $3k feed

sale.gates: Pilot at pyrolysis operator ~1 yr; catalyst qualification + scale-up by toll maker; offtaker fuel/feed specs, ISCC PLUS for the plant
